findings.oracle: Emits four real structlog events (INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL) through the real setup_logging pipeline, opens LogViewerWindow on the on-disk log, waits via qtbot.waitUntil until all four are backfilled (deterministic sync point), then calls set_min_level(logging.ERROR). Asserts exact equality visible_events == {'real_error_only','real_critical_only'} and visible_levels == {'ERROR','CRITICAL'}, explicit 'real_info_only'/'real_warning_only' NOT in visible_events, and exact proxy.rowCount() == 2. invalidateFilter() is synchronous so no timing race. Breaking the proxy filter (showing all rows) makes rowCount()==4 and the set/membership asserts fail.

Detection: plants a real HxD.exe (byte-copy of sys.executable) in a temp dir set as PATH; asserts find_hxd_executable() == planted, is_file(), and read_bytes() byte-identical; separate cases assert None when absent, None when a directory is named HxD.exe, and None off-win32. Construction: status_label asserted exactly 'HxD: not found' or f'HxD: {detected}' against an independent find_hxd_executable() call, and _update_status_label() renders exact planted path / not-found sentinel. Breaking the PATH probe or label formatter flips these exact-string/exact-path asserts red.

Replaced no-op guarded tests with unconditional TestHxDPanelFileLoading driving a real QProcess (editor=sys.executable opening a real sleeper .py). load_file(None-editor) asserts False and process is None; load_file(missing file) asserts False, process None, current_file unchanged; load_file(real file) asserts True, process.state()==Running, processId()>0, current_file==target; str-path coerced to Path and launches identically. Breaking the precondition checks or QProcess launch flips True/False and process-state asserts red.

Spawns a real child process then exercises teardown: terminate_existing() and stop_tool() assert process is None, embedded_container is None, and the real process.state()==NotRunning (genuine kill, not a state check on an idle panel). tool_closed/tool_started recorded into a list and asserted == [True] (emitted exactly once) combined with process-None state. double-terminate after a real load and cleanup() on a running process both assert NotRunning. Breaking _terminate_existing (skip terminate/kill) leaves state()==Running and fails the asserts.

Drives real state transitions on embed_info_label: from initial 'HxD not launched', load_file(real file) asserts label == f'HxD: {target.name}', then stop_tool() asserts label back to 'HxD not launched'. Removed smoke/type-only checks. Breaking the label-update in _launch_hxd_with_file or stop_tool flips these exact-string asserts red.
